title: Rabbi Yehoshua ben Uzaa
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: In Yoma 46b, Rabbi Yochanan says that Rabbi Yehoshua ben Uzaa asked a question; Rabbi Yochanan then says that Rabbi Yehoshua ben Uzaa subsequently resolved it. The Bach and Dikdukei Soferim read Rabbi Yehoshua Uzaa, without ben. On that reading, Hyman takes him to be the Rabbi Yehoshua of Uza mentioned in the baraita in Nedarim 38b; he would thus be a Tanna of a baraita.

notes.text: Uzaa without ben and man of Uza are Hyman’s grounds for proposing a Tanna identification. The finite Yoma 46b check did not locate the quoted wording; this is not proof of its absence from every edition.
The consulted Nedarim baraita reads Yehoshua of Uza, without the title Rabbi. Hyman’s identification with the figure in Yoma remains conjectural.
